summary: Processed all 17 open damage tickets (501-517) in id order: 503 and 508 were already recorded (resolved with existing adj ids); 501, 502, 504-507, 509, 510, 512, 514, 515, 516 had the missing damage recorded and were resolved; 511, 513 and 517 had insufficient stock and were set to pending. Ticket 515 initially returned a transient 403, was re-read successfully and processed; as it concerns a different sku it did not affect other reports.
